name: pr-watch
description: Event-driven GitHub PR watching: a Claude Code mod runs `gh webhook forward` per watched repo and turns each relevant pull_request / pull_request_review event into a session turn, with no polling and no Monitor expiry. Opt-in: the mod is installed into a dev-mods folder by `pr_watch.py install-mod`, never auto-loaded. Its settings are declared in `config` (read CLI > env > manifest > state config.json); `track` keeps an optional HTML tracker page in a configured Commons room.

config.PR_WATCH_PROMPT:
[pr-watch] {event}
Standing ask from the owner: keep watching these pull requests. If the head moved, re-review at the new head. If a review was requested from the owner, review it. Note merges and closes. Tell the owner only when something needs them; otherwise finish quietly.{track}
